draft.emotion: thorough and industrious, with the rhythmic sound of soap and water
notes: Used for objects (clothes, dishes, a car) and specific body parts (lavar as mãos, lavar o cabelo). For washing your whole body, use 'tomar banho'.

senses.definition: To clean something, or a part of the body, using water and usually soap.
